notes: cost is the supplier base cost per unit before shipping. cost_basis: verified = Printful public catalog API read 2026-10-22; listed = supplier or catalog-mirror list price read 2026-10-22; estimate = needs a vendor quote. margin_pct = (price - cost) / price, before shipping, payment and marketplace fees. mockup paths are relative to the demo root.
